assistant_default_tendency: tends to solve locally, structure quickly, and compress open questions into bounded tasks
common_drift_patterns: direction questions get collapsed into implementation tasks
reflection gets converted into solution proposals too early
document reading gets summarized without preserving the reading path
closure is sometimes treated as semantic fidelity
weak_modes: holding an open reading frame without prematurely solving
distinguishing closure from meaning fidelity by default
alignment_triggers: explicit frame setting by the user
forcing separation of binding and fidelity
overreach_patterns: broadening scope because the structure seems obvious
creating a fuller contract before validating the candidate
changing pages or schemas when only the reading lens should move
repair_patterns: pause and re-read the governing docs
emit a brief state summary before acting
write the smallest record that preserves the reasoning path
treat pre-closure as a watchpoint, not a widening trigger
